task_name: Prevent assistant output leaking across worktrees or panes
grader_mode: Host applies only the final test patch to a separate pinned snapshot, rebuilds and installs the wheel offline, runs the full project suite, then checks exact worktree/pane selection and output isolation against synthetic structured snapshots.

criteria.check: Only the exact worktree identity and tabId:leafId pane may supply assistant messages, even when decoys appear first.
Foreign-worktree and wrong-pane assistant messages never appear in the user-facing response.
Prompt, tool name, and tool input fields never appear in the user-facing response.
Ordinary structured completion does not read the terminal screen.
Extend test_find_exact_agent_by_worktree_and_pane_key and the compatibility fake/structured-completion test.
A fresh wheel built from the candidate installs offline and the full project suite passes.
Changes are limited to tests/test_orca_parsing.py and tests/test_harness_compatibility.py.
No live services, successful network access, publication, push, or merge.

baseline_calibration.result: functional isolation passes; direct parser regression coverage is incomplete
checks: Frozen synthetic host semantics pass on the pinned implementation.
Existing parser test uses one worktree and one other pane; compatibility coverage has decoys but lacks the same exact-row assertions requested for the parser fixture.
